messages:
Emma (Marketing): Short doc idea — 'Message Lab' for enterprise SLAs + security. Need a compact thing the field can use after the webinar.
Raj (Field Sales): Love it. Core asks: inbound lead routing rules, quick benchmark narrative, and a one-pager we can hand to prospects.
Kai (Product): We should make the narrative tight: decision for Hosted / Dedicated / Private with clear tradeoffs: latency, cost, compliance. Don't bury the fallback policies.
Linh (Solutions): I'll sketch a one-pager skeleton: 1) Customer pain; 2) Deployment options; 3) SLA tiers & what they buy; 4) Security controls; 5) Routing & lead qualification flow.
Emma (Marketing): Also want a short benchmark highlight: p50/p95 numbers and rough cost per 1M tokens for each mode. Keep it non-toxic — ranges acceptable.
Raj (Field Sales): Add qualification gates: data residency requirement, SLA minimum (e.g., 99.9%), throughput requirement (>500 req/s) -> Enterprise assignment.
Kai (Product): Quick baseline numbers from last infra run:
```
Hosted: p50 ~ 58ms, p95 ~ 220ms, cost ~$X per 1M tokens
Dedicated: p50 ~ 20ms, p95 ~ 75ms, cost ~$Y per 1M tokens
Private (on-prem): highly variable; typical p95 120–300ms depending on hardware and network
```
Linh (Solutions): For routing: propose simple rule set — if SLA>=99.9% or needs private networking -> route to enterprise queue and add Solutions review. If proof-of-concept and no strict residency -> route to self-serve / growth. Also include regional fallback: prefer same-region, else failover to compatible model variant.
Emma (Marketing): Draft messaging for the webinar segment (short bullets):
- Opening: "Why inference reliability is an operational problem, not just model choice."
- Core: "Unified runtime + smart routing = predictable latency & cost."
- Demo: show p50/p95 and an example failover from Hosted -> Dedicated.
- CTA: sign up for Enterprise readiness review -> triggers inbound routing rules.
Raj (Field Sales): For lead routing fields we need: company size, compliance needs (HIPAA/SOC2/Governance), required SLA, preferred region, expected qps. Add a checkbox for 'needs private/on-prem'.
Emma (Marketing): Can someone craft a 1-column one-pager (no more than 300 words) and a 2-sentence benchmark snapshot? We can use both in webinar follow-up.
Linh (Solutions): I'll drop a draft into this thread by EOD. Also adding a minimal YAML snippet for routing config:
```
inbound_routing:
  - criteria:
      sla_min: 99.9
      private_required: true
    route: enterprise_queue
  - criteria:
      company_size: "<100"
      compliance: none
    route: self_serve
  - criteria:
      fallback: true
    route: regional_compat
```
sre-bot: Deploy notice — routing service v2 pushed to staging (sha: a1b2c3). Verify configs before prod rollout.
Raj (Field Sales): Great — once Linh posts the draft I can annotate with qualification language that Sales needs.
Emma (Marketing): Thanks team. Goal: have marketing copy + one-pager + routing YAML + benchmark snapshot by Tomorrow 2pm PT. I'll schedule a 30m sync after the webinar to triage leads and handoff.
Kai (Product): Noted. I'll hand-off the benchmark slide and a short diagram of fallback routing.
Linh (Solutions): Draft incoming in ~4h.
Emma (Marketing): :thumbsup:
